notes.title: OYASUMII is OUT NOW
notes.notes:
Dear Dreamer,

The wait is over! OYASUMII is now available on Steam. Relive the nostalgia with OYASUMII, a horror and exploration game inspired by PSX and N64 classics. Enter liminal spaces and face surreal terrors in an adventure that challenges your skills and sanity. Are you ready to relive the golden age of video games with OYASUMII?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45059047/b48a18100182ef15e4758dcfb6ef32358216f9d2.gif[/img]

We would love to know your opinion. Leaving a review helps us immensely.
Thank you and enjoy the game!

We'll be waiting for you, dreamer.

With love,
NEO3000 & Jhoel Rubio

notes.title: 5 days until OYASUMII launches! ✨
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

[b]OYASUMII launches on March 7th![/b]

It's only a little while before the gates of Dream Quest Online open!

We're now less than 5 days away from OYASUMII launching here on Steam! Jhoel and I just wanted to thank you all for getting us this far. The excitement for the game has been amazing and has filled us with the energy needed to reach the finish line. We want to show you some of the many fan art pieces you've sent us.

notes.title: OYASUMII Devlog - DreamQuest Online #1
notes.notes:
Hello,

Today, we are thrilled to offer a glimpse into the world of OYASUMII.
Remember the excitement of exploring unknown worlds in classic PSX and N64 games? OYASUMII transports you back to that golden age, but with a terrifying twist.

Immerse yourself in Dream Quest Online, a virtual universe brimming with mysteries. Explore intricate labyrinths and unravel the secrets of a distorted world.

OYASUMII will be available on Steam on March 3rd.
